ratios.covenant_name: Consolidated Total Lease Adjusted Leverage Ratio
ratios.quote: increased the Consolidated Total Lease Adjusted Leverage Ratio (as defined in the A&R Credit Agreement) in Section 7.11(a) of the A&R Credit Agreement to be no greater than (1) 4.75 to 1.00 for the fiscal quarters ending September 29, 2026 and December 29, 2026

amended the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (as defined in the A&R Credit Agreement) in Section 7.11(b) of the A&R Credit Agreement to be no less than (1) 1.25 to 1.00 for the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2026 and thereafter

parsed.notes: The excerpt states only the covenant limits, not the actual ratios. The limits shown are those in force for the quarter ended September 29, 2026. The leverage maximum steps down to 4.50x from the quarter ending March 30, 2027. Excluded: the 4.00x leverage / 1.25x FCCR conditions on the restricted payment basket, the 4.50x lease-entry restriction, and the leverage-based pricing grid, because these are conditions or pricing terms rather than maintenance covenants. The Third Amendment (November 12, 2026) extended maturity to November 30, 2027 and cut the facility to $120.0 million. The excerpt also mentions going-concern and refinancing uncertainty around the debt maturity.
